title: P2 connected browser LoRA global-step proof
hypothesis: Two authenticated Burn CPU/WASM browser workers can complete disjoint frozen-base LoRA assignments whose exact adapter-only gradients are accepted, aggregated, optimized, checkpointed, and recovered by the coordinator within the declared numerical gates.

use_case.claim: Qualify the connected adapter-only coordinator path before promoting LoRA into persistent evaluated campaigns.

baseline.label: Independent centralized Python LoRA step
baseline.description: One Python FP32 update over the same complete four-row T0 batch from the same frozen base and initial adapters.

primary_metric.label: Accepted adapter checkpoint cosine similarity
primary_metric.description: Cosine similarity across all accepted adapter values relative to the independent centralized Python checkpoint.

repeated_validation_suite.label: Connected browser assignment gradients
repeated_validation_suite.description: Run two disjoint authenticated CPU/WASM assignments and compare every submitted adapter gradient to its assignment-specific Python oracle.

final_holdout_suite.label: Accepted adapter checkpoint and restart
final_holdout_suite.description: Compare the coordinator-owned adapter checkpoint to an independently generated Python step, restart the coordinator, and retrieve the identical adapter artifact.

guardrails.label: Complete adapter tensor set
guardrails.description: Each result and the checkpoint must contain exactly 8 declared tensors and 8,192 values without base gradients.

guardrails.label: At-most-once acceptance
guardrails.description: Both disjoint assignment identities must appear exactly once in the accepted-work ledger.

guardrails.label: Checkpoint relative L2
guardrails.description: Relative L2 error against the independent Python adapter checkpoint must not exceed 0.01.

guardrails.label: Restartable adapter state
guardrails.description: Coordinator restart must recover step, optimizer, cursor, loss history, attribution, the identical adapter artifact, and the same complete resume-state identity.

guardrails.label: Dense coordinator regression suite
guardrails.description: The established dense coordinator and browser contracts must remain green.

independent_variables.label: Connected adapter-only browser coordination
independent_variables.description: Replace isolated fixture execution with authenticated leased assignments and coordinator-owned aggregation, optimization, and persistence.

controlled_variables.label: Base, initial adapters, batch, and optimizer
controlled_variables.description: Hold the T0 base, rank-4 QKV adapter manifest, initial adapter identity, complete four-row batch, FP32 accumulation, clipping, and AdamW configuration fixed.
